name: Backup drill
description: Prove reversibility before you need it: snapshot, checkpoint, a reversible change, verify the journal, and rehearse the restore path.

steps.title: Snapshot
steps.detail: Call wp_site_snapshot to capture the current site state summary (versions, active theme/plugins, counts).

steps.title: Checkpoint
steps.detail: Call wp_create_checkpoint ('backup drill') and note the checkpoint id; list existing ones with wp_list_checkpoints to show retention.

steps.title: Make a reversible change
steps.detail: With owner consent, call wp_update_settings to change a harmless setting (e.g. blog description); capture the change_id from the response.

steps.title: Verify the journal
steps.detail: Call wp_list_changes (newest first) and wp_get_change (change_id) to show exactly what the journal recorded, then call wp_undo_change (change_id) to revert and verify with wp_get_settings.

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver: snapshot summary, checkpoint id, the drilled change + undo proof, and the restore paths available (checkpoint, undo, host-level backups).

guardrails: The drilled change must be cosmetic and self-reverted within the run.
Never drill with content deletion or user changes.
